title_en: SBPAC representatives attend the funeral of Narathiwat police officer and take care of inheritance rights.
summary_en: Today (October 28, 2569) at 12:30 p.m. in the village of Gubor Ban Joora, Village No. 3, Swawa Township, Rueso District, Narathiwat Province, Mr. Jarus Baphasena, Assistant Secretary of SBPAC (Public Relations Department), together with officials from Relief Group, attended a funeral ceremony for Lieutenant Colonel Usaman Nimyu, who died in an incident on October 17th.
